question: To what energy demand (MJ per kg isoprene) did the process fall at the highest feed isoprene concentration studied?
rendered:
Document 10: Process Simulation of Isoprene Recovery from Dilute Fermentation Off-Gas Using Absorption-Desorption

At a feed isoprene concentration of 4.3 wt %, the energy requirement fell to approximately 10 MJ kg^− 1.
